newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: HBG's Ways& Freitag in the red in 1996.
newsitem.headline: HBG's Ways& Freitag in the red in 1996.

text.p: Construction firm Hollandsche Beton Groep NV said on Friday its 74 percent owned German unit Ways & Freytag suffered a 1996 loss of 90 million marks on turnover of more than three billion.
"For 1997, Wayss & Freytag expects a significant improvement of results on a comparable turnover," the Dutch company said in a short statement.
In 1995, Wayss & Freytag posted a profit of 24.6 million marks on turnover of 2.62 billion.
HBG added the 1996 results of the German builder were in line with expectations. It bought the majority stake in the German firm at the end of 1996.
Wayss & Freytag's results will not be included in HBG's figures until the 1997 accounts.
HBG will publish its 1996 results on March 25.
